repairs: Correct LoBM and HiBM asset labels to growth and value respectively
Describe the unconditional specialist as a fixed rolling-window empirical law rather than expanding
Carry post-return drifted allocations into the next policy decision
Bind commands to exact releases, cutoffs, receipts, source identity and host admission

question: Does causal online stacking of four fixed rolling-window finite-law specialists improve joint monthly forecasts for six reconstituted US research portfolios?
scope: Development and data-revision robustness; not individual-security PIT confirmation, confirmation, or deployment

source.dataset: 6 Portfolios Formed on Size and Book-to-Market (2 x 3), value-weighted monthly returns

experts.unconditional: uniform empirical law over the latest 120 mature monthly outcomes
experts.recent: 36-month half-life weighted empirical law over the latest 120 mature monthly outcomes
experts.context: 24 nearest causal six-state contexts over the latest 120 mature monthly outcomes
experts.tail_regime: volatility and sign matched empirical law with 10 percent uniform shrinkage

primary.uncertainty: paired circular 12-month moving-block 95 percent interval, 5000 draws, seed 1911
primary.rule: both control-minus-stacked intervals above zero and both point improvements at least 5 percent in both folds

secondary.policy: fixed 25 percent grid, 50 percent per-asset cap, 95/5 nominal-worst log utility
secondary.cost_convention: one-way risky-weight turnover fee reduces investable wealth before the monthly return
secondary.state_transition: turnover from post-return drifted holdings; next holdings are the realized drifted allocation
secondary.rule: stacked terminal wealth exceeds equal-law policy, recent-law policy and both benchmarks in both folds; cannot rescue failed primary

integrity.archive: one bounded UTF-8 CSV or TXT member matching the frozen release-format contract
integrity.acquisition: exact URL-release allowlist, response metadata, SHA-256, byte count, package source identity, no overwrite
integrity.execution: fresh passing host receipt bound to interpreter and package source identity
integrity.retention: all months, scores, stack weights, allocations, wealth paths, benchmark paths, provenance, consumption, summaries and file hashes

stopping: Valid negative or inconclusive development closes this version; no outcome-driven threshold, fold, expert or block change
